note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published on PlayStation Network (via Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles). Every guide below is written in this guide's own words from the sources named beside each trophy, never copied. Four trophies were still unconfirmed by every guide on 19 Nov 2026 and are marked as such instead of guessed at.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles)
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks the moment the other 54 are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order: the five story chapters, the 100% Completion checklist after the credits, then Strangers & Freaks and the last secrets. No multiplayer, no DLC, one playthrough.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and unmissable. Play through Gone Fishing, Chapter 1's opening mission, and it pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and unmissable. It pops as Chapter 2 opens with What's in the Bag? — just finish Chapter 1.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and unmissable. It pops as Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, begins — finish Chapter 2.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and unmissable. It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life — finish Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and unmissable. It pops after Chapter 4's final mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and unmissable — the gold pops with the ending once you finish the final mission. There is no mission replay and no difficulty setting; one playthrough is enough.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and unmissable. It pops during Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 main mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and unmissable. It pops during The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 main mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and unmissable. It pops during Child's Play, a Chapter 4 main mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and unmissable. It pops during Headliners, a Chapter 4 main mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and unmissable. It pops during VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 main mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, automatic and unmissable. It pops during Operation Savage Glory, the Chapter 5 main mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The big one: open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story. The checklist is lenient — about 60% true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 100 optional missions, 8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations, 15 target decks, 15 of 18 meditations. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing for 100% is missable.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps. Mix the kinds; under-the-bridge runs are the quickest. For 100% you need 300 stunts. Track progress by region in Progress > Activities > Stunts, and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts 9 activity types — fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, video games, car races and stunts. Check them in Touchpad > Progress > Activities. Most come naturally from the story and the 100% checklist; the map's Activities filter (blue dumbbell icon) marks the rest.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 12 shooting ranges with 42 gold medals to earn in total. Golds need fast, accurate shooting — learn each range's scoring and retry freely; nothing here is missable. PowerPyx lists all 12 range locations and the 42 golds.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — 42 drone races in all. Each location's race must be won, not just entered; retry freely, nothing is missable.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — there are 40 unique race locations, so pick the easiest formats and skip the rest. Each new location you win in adds to the total.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot marked purple on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is at arcade machines around the world. Finish all levels of one game once — you don't need every challenge.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and gets marked in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and texts her address in Belville. Finish all 5 Andy quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline gets marked in Chapter 1, after the mission Island Dreams. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — follow the purple chest markers, use the metal detector on the ocean floor, and bring each haul back to his shop in Key Lento. Kenton goes quiet for a stretch in Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapter 2–3, so nothing is missable. Track it in Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline gets marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish all 5 Billy quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, Hometown Heroes. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Only certain strands count — Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle, Yago, and Pilot Pete. Other optional questlines (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie) do not count toward this trophy. Each strand is several missions; all of them stay available in free-roam after the story. The trophy tracker in the trophy list shows your count.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List gets marked after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso with the Key Cloner. Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list — he marks some in fixed spots, the rest you can steal off the street; scanning a car with WAiNK shows whether it's wanted. Track it on the map under Robberies > Randy's Wish List. Doable entirely after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and gets marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the Synthetic Labs marked purple in Vice City (the Take Out Kitty Litter quest), then Tyrone offers Spin On This to shut the labs down. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; each spot counts double if Jason and Lucia meditate there together. Track it in Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE ONLY POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she wants to meditate and walks to the balcony. Follow her and accept, and she teaches you to meditate. That home meditation is gone after Chapter 1, and it's not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it to be safe. The last meditation needs both characters playable together, which unlocks after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Note: 100% Completion only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so this can't block A Long Road.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and gets marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts about his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. His hunts ask for specific animals — bring them to Bret as Jason, using the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle he gives you. UNCONFIRMED as of 19 Nov 2026: PowerPyx notes it is still being confirmed which animal exactly unlocks this trophy, so this guide will not name one. Track the 15 Target Decks on the map under Activities — all 15 are needed for 100% anyway.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Find and complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets scattered around Leonida. Each set's cards are hidden in the world; PowerPyx lists all 18 set locations. Only 3 sets are needed, so pick the ones nearest your route.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK-scan 100 locations: hold Up + R1 on a scannable object. Landmarks (31), curiosities (35) and sculptures (23) are the bulk — scan whatever you pass and the count climbs on its own. Any 100 count, and there are well over 100 to find.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. For 100% you need 70, so this pops on the way. View and track them in Progress > Challenges; 10 more than needed are available, so skip the hardest ones and pick the quickest.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Unlocks once you can free-roam with your partner, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — call your partner with Right + Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level, then escape the red heat zone (a fast sports bike through traffic works; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County loses helicopters). It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, which opens the big bank vault robberies.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Only after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), when you can play with your partner. Rob 3 shops in a row while keeping the flashing wanted level — wear an armored vest, carry sticky bombs and healing, and keep moving. The trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop; if it doesn't, hit a 4th. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs) are a good spot — loot a few items and crack the back-room safe in each.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles with the WAiNK app (hold Up to open it, then R1 to scan). Just stand on a busy road and scan everything passing — 557 vehicles exist at launch and scanning is enough, no need to drive them. The 200 needed for 100% covers this on the way. Check totals in Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) slows time and highlights weak spots — it drains the purple focus bar fast, so buff focus first with food, drinks, Adrenaline, or a wash/shower at home. Line up 5 enemies (gang members at gang operations work; it doesn't seem to count on soldiers, police or civilians) and drop them with an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the big passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA — it must be one connected to a boarding bridge, not the planes on the airfield. Easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the bridge, get in, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the strip and take off. Fly at least 1 km away from the airport and the trophy pops (slightly delayed).

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in, and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun and marks jewelry store robberies green on the map. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun (silent lockpick — kicking the door trips the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) — it teaches bank vault robbery: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag. After that, buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 a tip (purple van markers). Rob any 5 vaults — 8 exist, and 100% needs all 8. Each robbery gives an instant 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike and swap cars to lose the heat.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Comes free with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…: robbing the bank vault there counts as robbing an armored truck. Or do it early — block an armored truck near a bank in Vice City, sticky-bomb its back door, and escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are sold at the back of Yasmani's shop once his quests are done.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane — fly over every black-fogged area until the map is fully visible. PowerPyx's map guide names a good plane for the job.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs — 39 operations exist and 100% needs them all, so this pops on the way. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked from story progress. Track each gang's count in Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED as of 19 Nov 2026 — no guide has pinned down the exact trigger yet, and this guide will not guess one. The description points to enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so the trigger is a waterfront bar or venue along Ocean Beach. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown; check back as players crack it in launch week.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the window — only that car counts, a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS. The trophy pops a moment after you drive away.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation). It unlocks after escaping the police, not on pickup — and the valuables can be grabbed across repeat visits, so nothing is missable. The alley is marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength in Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). Only after Coffee Break (Chapter 2) can you switch between characters — always work out together (call your partner with Right + Triangle) so both train at once. Fitness clubs are on the map under Activities; you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) and a small demon face appears whenever an action counts. Robberies, escapes and fights all count, and most players hit 500 passively while chasing the other trophies — if you're short at the end, keep playing and it will come. Note: a Psycho or Irredeemable profile makes cops shoot on sight more often.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED as of 19 Nov 2026 — no guide has pinned down the exact trigger yet, and this guide will not guess one. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue ('second time's the charm'). Check back as players crack it in launch week.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg: at night after 2AM, alone, drive the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County. If a blinking car is parked at the roadside, follow the path into the woods to find the UFO (bright blue light). Approach it, and it drops an abducted woman — talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random; if the car isn't there, drive away and come back.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED as of 19 Nov 2026 — no guide has pinned down the exact trigger yet, and this guide will not guess one. PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle ('bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by'). Check back as players crack it in launch week.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 counts across all robberies, not at once; bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in one robbery once they unlock in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 total across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest — the priciest shops are Ammu-Nations, mod shops and tattoo studios. It counts across the whole game, so this pops naturally if you buy gear as you go.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total) through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, which arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. The 4 story garages don't count. Robberies in Chapters 3–4 are the fastest money.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses. To register 10 vehicles you need enough garage space first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Drive a stolen car to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register; later in Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Use cheap cars to keep the cost down.
